answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the velvet of a task receipt, and the nadir is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
